Resolves #18035

🌿 The tear-out guide stopped at the terminal and the adoption guide stopped at the render target; between them lay a lifecycle no page told — now one pane walks it, from the commit that lets it leave to the reload that brings its window back, and "where did my pane go" has an answer at every station.

`learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayoutsWindows.md` (new, 393 lines): a story-led guide that follows one pane through six stations — the one commit at the tear-out terminal, `detachItem` for a detached item and `transferItem` into a nested workspace; the vessel binding into the Group and the participant protocol (synchronous capture, asynchronous prepare, synchronous adopt and compensate, post-commit project; the WorkspaceSet's four callbacks and `preserveItemIds`; the two-way import rule and its lazy edge); the reconnect lease and the retention question the engine puts to the host, told through the measured lease-end story; in-gesture conversion and park (the activation wall, the strict native transaction and its two-consumer origin); the three roads home (Undo, Reset, Show here) and the transit window that fooled two maintainers; warm and cold reload in the decision record's restore order, with the boundary between them stated — a surviving worker keeps its objects and history, a restarted one restores the saved topology into new instances. Around the stations: the cast of owners quoted from their own docblocks, a benefits section framed as the reader's, a first-person maintainer account, and where to go next. Registered in `learn/tree.json` and the `PRIORITIES` map of `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs`; the pipeline-owned sitemap and llms outputs are untouched.

Evidence: L2 (guide lint, the relative-link guard, a headless Mermaid render with the repository's own mermaid build, the portal route rendered on the dev server) → L2 required for the registration, diagram and consistency ACs; the "real headed journey" AC is discharged by committed witnesses, not a run made for this PR — `WorkstationReclaimEmbodimentNL.spec.mjs` (PR #18647, open: tear-out birth, same-pane continuity, lease-end retention with the never-bound witness, reintegration by Reset, Undo and Show here; 3 passed today at 40d1f849d9 with the runtime root) and, for conversion and parking, the committed `DemoBVesselConversionNL.spec.mjs` and `WorkstationHumanPopupOverlapNL.spec.mjs`, cited and not re-run here (headed native conversion opens real OS windows; the portability matrix carries the platform receipts). Residual: the independent cross-family whole-guide review the ticket names is this PR's review.

## Grounding evidence (review round 1, RA-4)
- The transit numbers — document +32 ms, popup empty +51 ms, pane embodied +333–360 ms; Undo +11 / +50 / +109 ms — measured at `fdca66095b` with the root resolver recorded: [Deliverable 1 — the isolation, measured](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18621#issuecomment-5647537174) (Vega).
- Grace's sentence, in her own words: [her endorsement of the re-scope](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18621#issuecomment-5647591004) and [the same words on the trigger's PR](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/18595#issuecomment-5647589023) — "A green arm that contradicts my claim is evidence against the claim, not a fence around it." The guide quotes it verbatim and names the comment as its source.
- The lease lesson: [Item 3 — isolated, and promoted](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18621#issuecomment-5648826780) — the popup closed at +111…151 ms before its app bound, slot `{generation: 0, windowId: null}`, `settleDockPane` at ≈ 20 s (19,966 / 19,990 / 20,039 ms on the rig's clock in the session reports), the stack `settleDockPane ← reintegrateItem ← onBindingReleased ← expired ← NativeLifecycle.onLeaseExpired`, and the 21:45Z correction of the "released at +25 ms" reading that the guide's first draft still carried; [Deliverable 1, second half](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18621#issuecomment-5647595870) for the rendered-vessel control and the two sightings.
- Warm versus cold reload: `apps/workstation/view/ViewportController.mjs#createRoot` (only the root binding reads storage; `TopologyLibrary` hydrated from IndexedDB; a new Workspace constructed with the selected topology), `src/manager/Transaction.mjs#createGroup` (`history: null`), the cold hydrate as a preserving `cursorAction` write (`test/playwright/unit/apps/workstation/WorkspacePerspective.spec.mjs`).
- The two terminal operations: `apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs#onTearOutDocumentChange` (a `detachItem` result received, a `transferItem` committed into the vessel's document) and ADR 0029 §2.3 (`transferItem` removes the source tree and catalog entry and adopts the record atomically; `detachItem` keeps the record).
- The survey bound: ADR 0029 §4 — five surveyed libraries, capability-scoped, an undocumented mechanism marked as such, a revalidation trigger named.
